blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI applied to Process Industries & Chemicals. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Process industries run on continuous physics: yields, energy and safety windows decided by process telemetry. Advanced process control plus predictive maintenance plus energy intelligence is the classic compounding stack — now with agentic planning on top.

items: APC setpoints static while feedstock shifts; yield and energy losses accepted as normal.
Compressors, columns and boilers hold failure precursors nobody sees.

blocks.x: The pattern composes LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Operations, AI Proof-of-Concept & Value Validation, Multimodal AI & Vision-Language Systems from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (APC/advanced control, Predictive maintenance, Batch genealogy/investigation) on Dataq Compass and Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — IEC 62443 / ISA S84 among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Models that read scans, scenes and schematics: multimodal intelligence wired into operations.
Voice and avatar interfaces that resolve, not deflect — with emotion-aware escalation and full auditability.
Replace hype with evidence: feasibility, value and adoption risk proven on your data in 6-10 weeks.
ML models augmenting control loops with constraint awareness (yield up 2-5 points)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Manufacturing & Industrial level this capability reads as: multivariate telemetry models flagging drift before scrap is produced (scrap and rework cost down 15-25%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
